author: Gunawan Kartapranata
description: Karedok, raw vegetables in peanut sauce topped with krupuk bawang (onion crackers), a traditional Sundanese food in Laksana restaurant, Sangkanhurip, Kuningan, West Java.

author: Andini Rizky
description: Nasi Timbel, cooked rice wrapped in banana leaves, served with grilled fish, Sayur Asem, and Lalap.

title: File:Sayur asem Lembang.JPG

description: Sayur asem, vegetable and tamarind soup

title: File:Cendol in a Glass.JPG
author: Gunawan Kartapranata
description: A Glass of Cendol at a bus stop in front of National Museum of Indonesia, Jakarta. Cendol is Indonesian traditional sweet ice-beverage made from green jelly, coconut milk, shredded ice, and coconut sugar.

title: File:Pepes ikan emas (pais lauk mas) Sunda.jpg
author: Gunawan Kartapranata
description: Pais lauk mas (pepes ikan mas), a carp fish in spices and herbs cooked in banana leaf package. A popular Sundanese cuisine. The specialty cooking of Ibu Sulastri, Rawasari, Central Jakarta.
